StudySession.title: StudySession
StudySession.description: Logs a completed student focus session with duration, subject tag, and distractions blocked.

userId.description: Authenticated UID of the student who completed the session.

subjectTag.description: Study subject category (e.g., Engineering, Coding, Exam Prep, Mathematics).

distractionsBlocked.description: Number of Shorts, distracting videos, or tab switches blocked during the session.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the session was logged via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the session was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

StudyRoom.title: StudyRoom
StudyRoom.description: Live multiplayer collaborative student study room with synchronized Pomodoro timer.

roomCode.description: 6-character alphanumeric invite code for the room.

roomName.description: Display title of the collaborative study room.

subjectTag.description: Primary study subject tag for the room.

hostId.description: Authenticated UID of the student who created the room.

hostName.description: Display name of the host student.

visibility.description: Room visibility scope for list queries.

timerDurationMinutes.description: Group Pomodoro target duration in minutes.

activeMembersCount.description: Number of students actively studying in the room.

lastReaction.description: Latest silent accountability reaction sent in the room.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the room was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the room was updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

RoomMember.title: RoomMember
RoomMember.description: Live status, focused minutes, and distraction count of a student in a collaborative study room.

roomId.description: ID of the study room this member record belongs to.

subjectTag.description: Current subject being studied by the student.

status.description: Real-time focus telemetry status of the student.

focusedMinutes.description: Total focused minutes completed in this room for leaderboard ranking.

distractionCount.description: Total distraction events logged in this room.

lastReaction.description: Latest accountability badge/reaction from this student.

visibility.description: Visibility aligned with the study room.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the member joined via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the member status updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/study_sessions/{sessionId}.description: User-isolated study session history for focus analytics and streaks.

/study_rooms/{roomId}.description: Collaborative student study rooms supporting group Pomodoro and leaderboards.

/room_members/{memberId}.description: Live student presence and leaderboard telemetry inside study rooms.
